matches.quote: Trapped hydrocarbons, bubbles, strain or a slightly enlarged vdW gap would reduce h_E and could create pinning sites, with or without a twist.
Only one twisted sample is reported.
The intermediate energies and gradual steps (Fig. 4c,d) are assigned to a canted state. They are equally consistent with mixed AP/P domains within the laser spot.
The extracted hard-axis field rises from h_y = 1.06 T (pristine) to 1.42–1.61 T (twisted)... A 50% increase is hard to reconcile with "twisting primarily tunes interlayer exchange".
The extracted hard-axis field rises from h_y = 1.06 T (pristine) to 1.42–1.61 T (twisted). The intermediate-axis field changes from 0.36 to 0.18–0.29 T.
h_P− varies from ~0 to 0.16 T and h_E from 0.144 to 0.19 T across spots a few µm apart. This variation could equally reflect inhomogeneous interlayer contact
reversal proceeds by nucleation and domain-wall motion, not uniform rotation... They are equally consistent with mixed AP/P domains within the laser spot.
This variation could equally reflect inhomogeneous interlayer contact, local twist-angle disorder, or strain. No independent local structural information discriminates these.
The diffraction-limited laser spot (~1 µm) averages over ~10⁴ moiré cells (λ_moiré ≈ 7–9 nm...). The data cannot distinguish coherent averaging from fine-scale domain textures.
It implies the twist (or interface) mainly adds pinning or coercivity and only moderately reduces exchange
No comparison is made with the position-dependent J_inter of Liu et al. (ref. 33)... compare h_E(θ) with the spatial average of the ab initio J_inter(r) of ref. 33.
No quantitative criterion is given, e.g., comparing the domain-wall width √(A/K) or the intralayer exchange length with λ_moiré, as in Hejazi et al.
The observed AP→P field is the very field that defines the loop width. It is excluded from the fit because including it "produces unphysical values"

notes: C10 is judged 'partly' because the review flags the same multi-step/intermediate features in Fig. 4c,d as evidence of mixed domains rather than a monodomain canted state (P16), but requests spectral decomposition rather than minor loops at position 3. C17 is judged 'partly' because the review addresses the larger B//c saturation field via the resulting 50% jump in extracted hard-axis anisotropy h_y (P3) and incomplete c-axis saturation (P10). C3 is 'partly' because the review notes the lack of local structural characterization to rule out strain (P22, P4) without specifically requesting a strain map.
